buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address DIG SHQ(Lucknow) mohanlalganj Lucknow UP . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1-The work of all vehicles put in the bid is to be done at the Regional Headquarters Lucknow, for which th e bidders will have to come to the Regional Headquarters Lucknow before participating in the bid and phys ically check the vehicles and its equipment, only after that they will participate in the bid. 2- In this bid, the work of vehicles will be done one by one, and for the vehicle whose work is to be done, t he bidders will send one of their skilled experts and get the work done. The total time limit for doing all the work will be 45 days, accordingly the bidders will participate in the bid by determining the rate. The time li mit of work will not be reduced or more than 45 days. 3- The seller will provide only genuine spare parts and all items required will be warranted, which will be c ompleted at the office i.e. Sector Headquarter Lucknow. 4- Before bidding to ensure proper naming of spare parts number and item- Before submission of bid, the bidder shall physically check all the vehicles at the headquarters. It shall be the responsibility of the bidder to work and complete the work of all machine job and repair work of vehicles at his own expense and leave all unserviceable parts at the given address. 5- All vehicles are parked in the sector workshop for engine machine job work and other repair work. The work of one vehicle will be done at a time and after the repair work of the first vehicle is completed, the wo rk of the second vehicle will be started. 6- After executing the engine, machine job work and other equipment of the vehicles, the bidders will be b ound to work the equipment efficiently for at least six months. If any equipment or part develops defects, i t shall be repaired by the bidders without any additional charge, or a new part or equipment shall be provi ded. 7- All items have to provide one year warranty which has to be fulfilled at the office i.e. Sector Headquarte rs Lucknow. .
